mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ixtal's Impact</titleLeft><mainText>Skarner is charging toward his prey.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge.

Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals @PinDamage@ physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for @StunDuration@s.

Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Successful wall collisions reduce this Ability's cooldown to @RefundPercent*100@%.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Skarner ends his charge and releases any pinned victim.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Skarner's Attacks, <spellName>Shattered Earth</spellName>, <spellName>Upheaval</spellName>, and <spellName>Impale</spellName>, apply <keywordMajor>Quaking</keywordMajor> for @Duration@s. At @StacksToTriggerPassive@ stacks of <keywordMajor>Quaking</keywordMajor>, enemies take <magicDamage>@PercentHealthDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> over its duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_Skarner_Passive_Tooltip}}

Total damage to monsters is capped at @DamageMonsterCap@.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Quaking</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is Quaking from Skarner. When Quaking is at 3 stacks this unit takes damage over time.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Shattered Earth / Upheaval</titleLeft><mainText>Skarner is holding a boulder, which empowers his attacks and will deal tons of damage when thrown.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed and dealing @AbilityDamage@ physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional @MaxHPPercent*100@% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by @SlowPercent*100@% for @SlowDuration@s.

Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing @spell.SkarnerQ:AbilityDamage@ + @spell.SkarnerQ:MaxHPPercent*100@% max Health physical damage, and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowPercent*100@% for @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowDuration@s.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Percent Health Damage to monsters is capped at @MonsterDamageCap@.
This Ability deals @TurretDamageMod*100@% to structures.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Skarner's tails lash forward, dealing @Damage@ magic damage and Suppressing the first 3 champions he hits for @Duration@s. Those hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of this Ability.

If Skarner hits at least one champion he gains @SpeedBoostAmount*100@% Move Speed for @SpeedBoostDuration@ seconds.

If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will cast Upheaval first.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Impale</titleLeft><mainText>This champion has been Impaled by Skarner.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Skarner gains <shield>@InitialShield@ Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@s and triggers an earthquake that deals <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slows</status> nearby enemies by @SlowEffect*-100@% for @SlowDuration@s.
